before.title: Blank / Partial Instrument Cluster on Cold Start (Combination Meter Recall 26V331)
before.description: Roughly 51,598 redesigned 2025-2026 Kicks (built June 24, 2024-January 9, 2026) have a software logic error in the combination meter that causes a communication breakdown between electronic controllers during a cold start. The cluster may then show a partial image, a blue screen, or go entirely blank, hiding safety information such as speed, warning lights, and telltales. Nissan logged 7 technical reports and 205 warranty claims before issuing recall 26V331.
before.solution: Recall 26V331 remedy: Nissan dealers reprogram the combination meter software (about 0.5 hour) free of charge. Owner notification letters mailed beginning July 1, 2026 — verify VIN status at a Nissan dealer or nhtsa.gov.
symptoms: Dashboard / gauge cluster goes fully or partially blank on startup
Blue screen or partial image on the instrument display
Speedometer and warning lights not visible after a cold start

before.title: CVT Drone and Noise at Highway Speeds
before.description: The Kicks' CVT produces excessive drone and noise at highway speeds (60-75 MPH). The CVT holds high RPMs (3,500-4,000) for highway cruising due to the small 1.6L engine's limited torque, creating a constant loud droning noise in the cabin. This is partly a design characteristic of the powertrain but is significantly louder than competitors. Sound deadening in the Kicks is minimal.
before.solution: This is largely a design characteristic that cannot be fully eliminated. Aftermarket sound deadening material (Dynamat or similar) applied to the doors, floor, and firewall can reduce interior noise by 3-5 dB ($200-$500 DIY). Higher-quality tires designed for low road noise (Michelin Defender, Continental TrueContact) also help. Some owners report slightly lower RPMs and noise after a CVT fluid change.
symptoms: Loud droning noise at highway speeds
Engine RPMs stay high at 60-75 MPH
Difficult to hold conversation at highway speed
Wind and road noise excessive
CVT holds RPMs at 3,500-4,000 cruising

before.title: Electric Power Steering (EPS) Assist Loss — Torque Sensor Weld Failure (Recall PMA25/PMA26)
before.description: Certain 2021 Kicks (built July 19-September 27, 2021) have an intermittent electrical connection in the electric power steering torque sensor caused by poor weld penetration at a terminal that can disconnect. When it fails, EPS assist is disabled, a warning light illuminates, and steering reverts to much heavier manual effort, increasing crash risk. Nissan recalled 2021 Kicks and Versa vehicles after investigating loss-of-assist incidents.
before.solution: Recall remedy PMA25/PMA26: Nissan dealers inspect the steering column torque sensor lot code and replace the steering column assembly if an affected lot is found, free of charge. Verify the VIN against the recall at a Nissan dealer or nhtsa.gov.
symptoms: Steering suddenly becomes very heavy / hard to turn
EPS / power steering warning light illuminates
Loss of power steering assist while driving

before.title: Engine Stalling / Shutting Off While Driving (Throttle Body, MAF Sensor, ECM Software)
before.description: Many 2018-2020 Kicks owners report the engine stalling or shutting off, often when slowing to a stop and in some cases at speed, sometimes with a delayed restart. Dealers and forums commonly trace it to the throttle body, a contaminated mass airflow (MAF) sensor, or outdated ECM software; throttle-body replacement and ECM reprogramming have resolved repeat cases. RepairPal documents engine-stalling as a recognized Kicks complaint, frequently alongside DTC P0101.
before.solution: Have the dealer scan for stored codes (commonly P0101) and check for applicable ECM reprogramming before replacing parts. Common fixes include cleaning or replacing the MAF sensor, replacing the throttle body and gasket, and applying the latest ECM software update.
symptoms: Engine dies at idle or when coming to a stop
Vehicle shuts off while driving
Hard or delayed restart after a stall
Rough idle, possible check engine light

If freezing or random reboots persist, have a Nissan dealer apply the latest infotainment/audio firmware update (per TSB) or diagnose the head unit.

before.title: Rear Drum Brake Squeal and Dust Contamination
before.description: The Kicks uses rear drum brakes (a cost-saving measure) that develop squealing, grinding, and poor performance from brake dust accumulation. The semi-sealed drum design traps dust and debris, causing noise and inconsistent braking. The issue is worse in dusty or wet environments. The drums also warp easily, causing a pulsation felt through the brake pedal.
before.solution: Remove rear drums and clean all components with brake cleaner. Inspect shoes for glazing and contamination — sand the shoe surface lightly with 120-grit sandpaper if glazed. Check drums for scoring and measure for out-of-round (max 0.006"). Replace shoes and drums if worn. Apply brake grease to the backing plate contact points. Clean rear brakes every 20,000 miles as preventive maintenance.
symptoms: Squealing or squeaking from rear brakes
Grinding noise when braking
Brake pedal pulsation
Poor rear braking performance
Noise worse in wet or dusty conditions

before.title: Rearview Camera Image Disappears / Stays Off (AV Control Unit Recall 19V654)
before.description: On 2018-2019 Kicks, the backup-camera display setting can be adjusted so the rearview image is no longer shown, and the AV control unit retains that setting on the next reverse event, leaving the driver with no camera image when backing up. This fails FMVSS No. 111 (rear visibility). Nissan issued voluntary recall 19V654 covering the Kicks among roughly 1.2 million Nissan/Infiniti vehicles.
before.solution: Free recall remedy (19V654 / R1911): Nissan dealers reprogram the AV control unit software so the camera defaults to displaying the rearview image at the start of each reverse event. Verify VIN status at a Nissan dealer or nhtsa.gov.
symptoms: No image on screen when shifted into reverse
Backup camera view turns off and stays off
Camera display setting not resetting between reverse events
